subject: Site-visit calendar squeeze — propose alternate demo window
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tara Nguyen <tara@sunridgehealth.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@sunridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo week — quick confirmation of attendee availability

Tara / Michael —

Thanks again for carving time for a Sunridge field visit the week of May 17. We circulated a draft agenda and MAP this morning (attached) to make the onsite productive for your team. Before I block flights, quick check: can you confirm whether Dr. Patel will be available for the afternoon Q&A on Tuesday? We originally held that slot because your calendar indicated an internal review, but I noticed a travel flag on his calendar.

If Dr. Patel is out, happy to swap the Tuesday afternoon deep-dive for a Wednesday slot or split the session into two 45-minute blocks so the decision team can dial in. What would you prefer?

Connor
Connor O'Brien | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Tara Nguyen <tara@sunridgehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@sunridgehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 18:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week — quick confirmation of attendee availability

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the agenda and MAP. Quick update: Dr. Patel has a last-minute accreditation site visit in Boston the week of May 17; he won't be on-site or available in the Tuesday afternoon slot. Apologies — this only popped up in the calendar today.

Two options that work on our end:
- Move the deep-dive to Wednesday May 19, 2:00–3:30 PM local time (Dr. Patel will be back that morning).
- Keep Tuesday but have Dr. Patel join remotely for the last 45 minutes and we can record for him.

If you think the hands-on session benefits from in-person presence, we'd prefer Wednesday. If switching the schedule is painful for your team, we'll do the remote join.

Tara
Tara Nguyen | Director, Clinical Informatics
Sunridge Health
tara@sunridgehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3344
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 07:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onsite demo week — quick confirmation of attendee availability

Team —

Tara just flagged that Dr. Patel will be out Tuesday afternoon. Prospects prefer we move the deep-dive to Wed 2:00–3:30 if we can. Two asks:
1) Marissa — can you cover the hands-on session logistics for Wed 2:00–3:30 (room setup + demo env prep)?
2) Aditya — if we pivot to Wed, can you bring the GPU-backed inference cluster for the live latency run? We had planned for Tuesday; want to confirm resource availability and any cost implications.

If either of you think we should keep Tue + remote Dr. Patel, shout now. I lean to moving — in-person will help with the clinical workflow review.

Connor

Wednesday May 19, 14:00–15:30 works for me. I'll rebook the onsite room and coordinate with facilities for projector and network VLAN access. Aditya, if you confirm the cluster, I'll update the MAP and send an updated calendar invite.

If Dr. Patel prefers remote for any portion, we'll have a dedicated laptop and recorded session available. I'll also add a short pre-demo checklist to the MAP (WiFi SSID, local admin access, sample patient dataset notes).

Tara — I'll send the revised invite and an updated MAP by EOD.

Thanks —
